all_dek: The episodes of anti-Black violence that took place in August of the years sampled so far (1885, 1903, and 1920), from a series that will reach across 1800–1922, placed on 1910 county lines. Years with nothing on the timeline have not been collected yet. Choose a year to see its August day by day. Full-year atlas: 1903. Compare the lynchings with the inventories. Hover for a short summary; select a dot to read the account in the sidebar. Drafts: no entry has had human review.
